{{Top|canon=Belters}}
A '''belter''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[blood profession]]. Belters mined [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and passed their skills down to their children. In the event that there were more Ugnaughts than there were available job positions, a [[blood duel]] was called where Ugnaughts fought a series of battles to the death to inherit their blood profession.
